title: 항공정보간행물발간규정 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Sale of the Publication, etc.)
(1) The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall sell the Publication for a fee: Provided, That the Publication may be distributed free of charge to any of the following institutions: <Amended on March 14, 2008; March 23, 2013; January 2, 2019>
1. Relevant government agencies;
2. Foreign governments or international organizations.
(2) The selling price of the Publication under paragraph (1) shall be determined by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport within the scope of the actual expenses incurred in its publication. <Amended on March 14, 2008; March 23, 2013>
